why: Each Ruche package in this project must be runnable from a tracked-only clean checkout with no dependency on any other task directory. This task therefore carries its OWN byte-identical copy of the certified instrumentation rather than reaching sideways into TASK-2026-09-01-SMCRUCHE-READY/support/. That predecessor copy IS tracked, so a cross-task path would work today, but it would make this package's correctness depend on a sibling task nobody is maintaining. Self-containment is cheaper than that coupling.
closure_method: Inherited verbatim from TASK-2026-09-01-SMCRUCHE-PACKFIX, which computed it by ast.parse of instrumented.py, walking Import/ImportFrom nodes and following any resolving to a sibling module in the (untracked) SMCSTAT analysis directory. Result: no sibling imports at all. Re-verified here: the file's import closure over non-stdlib, non-numpy, non-pps_qj modules is EMPTY.
not_bundled_because_tracked: pps_qj (the production package, tracked in this repository)

files.note: Copied verbatim. NOT rewritten, NOT reformatted, NOT re-implemented. This is the exact file that produced every frozen ARM1/ARM2 result and that TASK-2026-08-30-SMCSTAT validated bitwise against the production path. Its dtau_mult default is the certified 6.0, never the corpus 12.0.
